blocks.en: §5 Glossary: Official Definitions and Commentary

blocks.zh: 三組容易混淆的術語對
blocks.en: Three Pairs of Easily Confused Terms

blocks.zh: Disturbances vs. Transient Events：干擾一定是非計畫性的；暫態事件包含計畫性（啟動）和非計畫性（干擾）兩類
blocks.en: Disturbances vs. Transient Events: A disturbance is always unplanned; a transient event covers both planned events (start-up) and unplanned events (disturbances)

blocks.zh: Steady State vs. State of Control：穩定狀態是「不變化」；受控狀態是「在可接受範圍內變化」；CM 只要求後者
blocks.en: Steady State vs. State of Control: Steady state means "no change"; state of control means "variation within an acceptable range"; CM requires only the latter

blocks.zh: Process Dynamics vs. RTD：RTD 是製程動力學的一個量化工具；製程動力學更廣泛，包含對所有輸入變化的響應
blocks.en: Process Dynamics vs. RTD: RTD is one quantitative tool of process dynamics; process dynamics is broader and covers the response to all input changes

blocks.zh: Q13 的 ICH Q 系列位置
blocks.en: Where Q13 Sits in the ICH Q Series

blocks.zh: ICH Q13（2022）在 Q12（2019）完成生命週期管理框架之後發布，反映連續製造已從「探索性技術」進入「法規成熟」階段。Q13 是少數「同時適用於化學藥物和生物藥物」的 ICH Q 指引之一。
blocks.en: ICH Q13 (2022) was issued after Q12 (2019) completed the lifecycle management framework, reflecting that continuous manufacturing has moved from an "exploratory technology" to a "regulatory-mature" stage. Q13 is one of the few ICH Q guidelines that apply to both chemical drugs and biological drugs.

blocks.zh: Q13 核心決策流程：從設計到申報
blocks.en: Core Q13 Decision Flow: From Design to Submission

blocks.zh:
1. 定義批次
   → 選擇批量定義方法（時間/重量/組合）

2. 設計控制策略
   → 建立 RTD 模型
   → 設計物料轉向策略（RTD + 安全邊際）
   → 確定取樣策略（頻率與時間區間）

3. 決定是否使用 RTRT
   → 是：建立參考測試方法 + 資料缺口備援
   → 否：傳統離線放行測試

4. 製程驗證方式
   → 傳統 PV（固定批次）
   → 或 CPV（需提供科學合理性）

5. CTD 申報
   → 依 Table 1 映射各 CM 資訊至對應章節
   → 3.2.S.2.6/P.2.3 提供控制策略摘要+連結
blocks.en:
1. Define the batch
   → Select the batch size definition approach (time / mass / combination)

2. Design the control strategy
   → Build the RTD model
   → Design the material diversion strategy (RTD + safety margin)
   → Determine the sampling strategy (frequency and time interval)

3. Decide whether to use RTRT
   → Yes: establish the reference test method + data gap contingency
   → No: conventional offline release testing

4. Process validation approach
   → Traditional PV (fixed number of batches)
   → Or CPV (scientific justification required)

5. CTD submission
   → Map each item of CM information to the corresponding section using Table 1
   → 3.2.S.2.6/P.2.3 provide a control strategy summary + links

blocks.zh: 全文綜合練習題
blocks.en: Comprehensive Review Question for the Full Document

blocks.zh: 某公司擬為化學藥品建立全新的 CM 製造系統（直接壓縮錠劑），計畫在首次上市即採用 CPV，批量以時間範圍定義（180-360 分鐘 × 固定質量流率），且採用 NIR 模型進行 RTRT。請說明：(1) 批量範圍申報的 CTD 位置；(2) CPV 合理性說明的 CTD 位置；(3) NIR RTRT 模型資訊的 CTD 位置。
blocks.en: A company plans to establish a brand-new CM manufacturing system for a chemical drug product (direct compression tablets), intends to use CPV from the first commercial launch, defines batch size by a time range (180-360 minutes × fixed mass flow rate), and uses an NIR model for RTRT. Please explain: (1) where the batch size range is filed in the CTD; (2) where the CPV justification is filed in the CTD; (3) where the NIR RTRT model information is filed in the CTD.

blocks.zh: 解答
blocks.en: Answer

blocks.zh: (1) 批量範圍：主要放在 3.2.P.3.2（Batch Definition），說明批量定義方法（run time × mass flow rate）及擬申請範圍合理性；在 3.2.P.2.3 提供摘要（含批量範圍合理性的製程開發背景）。
blocks.en: (1) Batch size range: Mainly placed in 3.2.P.3.2 (Batch Definition), describing the batch size definition approach (run time × mass flow rate) and the justification for the proposed range; a summary is provided in 3.2.P.2.3 (including the process development background supporting the batch size range).

blocks.zh: (2) CPV 合理性：在 3.2.P.2.3（製程開發）的控制策略摘要中提供合理性說明（基於製程理解、系統設計、控制策略三要素）；CPV 方案詳細資訊放在 3.2.R（Regional Information）。
blocks.en: (2) CPV justification: The justification is provided in the control strategy summary in 3.2.P.2.3 (process development), based on the three elements of process understanding, system design, and control strategy; detailed CPV plan information is placed in 3.2.R (Regional Information).

blocks.zh: (3) NIR RTRT 模型：主要放在 3.2.P.5（藥品管制章節），包含：模型摘要與取樣策略合理性、設備故障或資料缺口時的應急測試計畫、分析模型驗證資訊。若也用於中間製程測試，則在 3.2.P.3.4 交叉引用；模型開發背景在 3.2.P.2.3；高影響模型的完整驗證資料在 3.2.R。
blocks.en: (3) NIR RTRT model: Mainly placed in 3.2.P.5 (control of drug product), including the model summary and justification of the sampling strategy, the contingency testing plan for equipment failure or data gaps, and analytical model validation information. If it is also used for in-process testing, cross-reference it in 3.2.P.3.4; the model development background goes in 3.2.P.2.3; complete validation data for a high-impact model go in 3.2.R.
